Please describe the appearance of your skin lesions in detail, including their color, shape, and any changes in size over time.

REQUEST TEST: Full skin examination with dermoscopy of all lesions.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Inspection reveals an erythematous plaque with areas of crusting and oozing, featuring irregular borders located on the dorsal surface of the penile shaft and the left middle finger. Palpation indicates the lesions are firm to touch, non-tender, and without warmth. Regional lymph nodes (cervical, axillary, inguinal) show no palpable adenopathy. Biopsy findings demonstrate cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within follicle-bearing epithelium. STD Panel results: Syphilis Negative, HIV Negative, HBV Negative, HCV Negative.
